BiblicalUsage: Jibleam is a place in Palestine, a town of Manasseh. In Joshua 17:11, Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and her towns. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jibleam matters because the gospel travelled through real places, and God met His people where they lived.
